title: Finance & HR Systems Administrator
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Finance & HR Systems Administrator to join a leading higher education institution on an interim basis. This role will be responsible for the administration, maintenance and continuous improvement of the organisation's Finance and People & Culture systems, ensuring systems are secure, efficient and aligned with business needs. The successful candidate will act as the key liaison between users, suppliers and stakeholders, providing expert systems support, managing upgrades and enhancements, and driving improvements across core business systems.

Key Responsibilities:
- Act as the primary administrator for Unit 4 ERPx and People First systems
- Manage user accounts, permissions and security access across Finance and People & Culture systems
- Provide first-line and second-line application support to system users
- Investigate, troubleshoot and resolve system issues in a timely manner
- Coordinate system upgrades, patches and enhancements with external suppliers
- Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) and support system implementation projects
- Develop and maintain system documentation, user guides and process maps
- Deliver training and support to users across the organisation
- Gather and assess business requirements and recommend system improvements
- Work closely with stakeholders to optimise system functionality and processes
- Produce system reports and support data analysis requirements
- Maintain system integrity, data quality and compliance with governance requirements
- Support integrations between Finance, HR and other business systems
- Manage relationships with system suppliers including Unit 4, MHR and other third-party providers
- Monitor system performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement
- Contribute to wider transformation and change programmes across the organisation
- Ensure all activities are delivered in line with organisational policies and procedures
- Provide expert advice on systems best practice and future development opportunities

Ideal Candidate Profile:
- Previous experience working in a Systems Administrator, Finance Systems Analyst, Application Support Analyst or similar role
- Strong experience administering Unit 4 ERPx, Agresso or similar ERP systems
- Experience supporting HR systems such as People First, MHR or equivalent platforms
- Knowledge of Finance and HR system processes and workflows
- Experience managing system upgrades, testing and implementation activities
- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
- Experience managing system security, user access and permissions
- Ability to produce reports and analyse system data
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
- Experience liaising with third-party suppliers and external partners
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple departments
- Experience within Higher Education, Public Sector or Not-for-Profit organisations would be advantageous
- A proactive approach to continuous improvement and systems development

Location: London

Working Pattern: Hybrid

Hours: Full-time

Length: 6 Months

Salary Equivalent: £200-£230 paid via an Umbrella

description:

invoices and payments on the finance system, responding to queries from colleagues and
3rd party partners. You will provide support for Head of Finance and Director Finance and
Operations where required, including data analysis, reporting and preparation of returns
across both finance and HR remits.

How to apply
To apply for this role please send your CV and cover letter (maximum two pages)
including responses to the three questions below:
1. Tell us about a time when you identified a process that could be improved or made
more efficient. How did you approach making the change, and what did you do to
ensure the process was accurate, consistent and effective?
2. Describe a situation where you had to handle sensitive financial or employee
information while also resolving a difficult or confidential issue. What approach did you
take?
3. Give an example of when you have had to manage competing priorities. How did you
decide what to do first, and how did you ensure important deadlines were met?

HR and Recruitment
- Maintain accurate data on our HR system including starters,
leavers, holiday and other absences
- Report on key employee metrics including sickness absence,
holiday, TOIL, diversity
- Support line managers with recruitment activity including
making effective use of the Applicant Tracking System to
ensure a good candidate experience and to report recruitment
metrics to enable continuous improvement
- Manage onboarding for new starters including reference
requests, pre-employment checks, induction processes
- Coordinate arrangements for training sessions for staff
- Support Head of Finance with monthly payroll processes
- Support Director of Finance and Operations in maintaining and
publicising HR policies, keeping the Employee Handbook
current
- Maintain up to date employee guides and templates for key HR
processes including appraisals, mid year reviews, recruitment,
induction, flexible leave

Finance Administration
- Maintain appropriate employee access to Finance Systems,
including being able to claim staff expenses and raise sales
invoice requests, and support employees in using these
systems.
- Respond to queries in the central accounts mailbox, liaising
with internal and external stakeholders.
- Support Head of Finance and Finance Officer with Purchase
Ledger, including posting and payment of supplier invoices in a
timely manner, ensuring accurate coding and authorisation in
line with limits, maintenance of supplier accounts,
reconciliations and remittances.
- Support Head of Finance and Finance Officer with management
of company credit cards and virtual cards, including reconciling
statements and accurate posting to the ledger.
- Assist in raising sales invoices and accurately recording income.
- Assist with Credit Control, chasing overdue debts and reporting
to the Head of Finance.
- Support Head of Finance with analysis of financial data from
the finance system (Xero) for reporting and other ad-hoc
purposes
- Assist in maintaining up to date procedures.
There is an opportunity to attend theatre press nights where
appropriate and to take advantage of trade tickets when offered

This role sits within the Finance and Operations team whose focus
is to ensure the organisations operate as effectively and efficiently
as possible. Our team operates across Finance, HR, Technology,
Facilities and Compliance, to ensure that systems and processes
are set up which promote smooth delivery and support the work
of the organisations. This includes adherence to regulatory
requirements and best practice standards

title: Temporary Internal Recruiter
description:

We are currently recruiting for an experienced Candidate Interviewing Specialist to join the Early Talent Recruitment team of a leading global organisation on an initial 6-month temporary contract.

You will be responsible for delivering a seamless and engaging candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey. Working Pattern

title: HR Assistant
description:
HR Assistant / HR Administrator

Salary: £26,000 £28,000 per annum
Type: Permanent, Full-time
Location: Harrow
Hours: 37.5 hours per week
Working pattern: Primarily office based, with limited hybrid working potentially available following successful probation

Ready to kick-start your career in HR?

If you already have some solid administration experience and are now looking for the opportunity to move into Human Resources, this could be the perfect next step.

Our client is looking for a bright, organised and highly detail-focused HR Assistant / HR Administrator to join their HR function. You do not need to have built your career in HR already what matters is that you have previous administrative experience, excellent attention to detail and a genuine enthusiasm for developing a long-term career within Human Resources.

You will receive excellent training, support and hands-on experience, giving you the chance to build practical knowledge across a wide range of HR activities. From recruitment and onboarding through to employee records, payroll information and HR documentation, this is an opportunity to develop a strong generalist HR foundation from the outset.

What will you be doing?

This is a varied role where no two days are likely to feel exactly the same. You will support the smooth running of day-to-day HR administration while gradually building your knowledge and confidence across the wider employee lifecycle.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Supporting recruitment activity, including reviewing CVs and coordinating interviews
- Helping with new starter onboarding and employee induction processes
- Maintaining accurate employee records and updating the HR system
- Preparing contracts and other HR documentation for review
- Supporting right-to-work and employee record administration
- Coordinating leaver processes and assisting with exit administration
- Providing accurate employee information for payroll processing
- Responding to routine employee queries in a professional and helpful manner
- Supporting the HR team with day-to-day administration and wider projects
- Handling confidential employee information with care and discretion
- Helping improve HR processes and administration as your experience develops

What are we looking for?

Essential:
- Previous administration experience
- Excellent attention to detail
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage several tasks at once
- Confident written and verbal communication skills
- Good Microsoft Office and general IT skills
- A professional approach when handling confidential or sensitive information
- A genuine interest in developing a career within HR
- A positive, reliable and proactive attitude

Desirable:
- Previous exposure to HR, recruitment or employee administration
- An HR, Business Administration or related qualification
- Experience using an HR system or similar business software
- A basic understanding of HR processes
- Experience using modern digital or AI-assisted tools in an administrative environment

Why Apply?

For someone looking to make their first real move into HR, this role offers an excellent platform from which to build a career.

You will gain exposure to a broad range of HR activities rather than being limited to one small area, with plenty of opportunity to learn from an experienced HR professional.

Most importantly, you will receive excellent training and ongoing support, allowing you to develop your HR knowledge at a sensible pace while taking on greater responsibility as your confidence grows.

If you are an experienced administrator who is meticulous, organised and serious about building a career in Human Resources, we would love to hear from you.

What You Need to Do Now:

If this sounds like the role for you, don t wait - apply today with your up-to-date CV!

If it s not quite right for you but you know someone perfect, refer them to us and receive a £100 voucher when they re placed and pass their probation period (terms apply). Visit our website to read more about our Double the Reward scheme in our blog.

All vacancies are advertised with written instruction from our clients. Where salaries or rates of pay are quoted, the nature of the work, location, and minimum experience, training or qualifications required are stated within the advert.

title: HR Recruiter
description:
Job Purpose:

We are looking for an In-House Recruiter to support end-to-end hiring, working closely with managers to recruit high-quality candidates while maintaining strong relationships and a positive candidate experience.

Key Responsibilities:
- Complete end-to-end recruitment.
- Be actively involved in recruitment by preparing job descriptions, posting adverts across job boards, LinkedIn, and internal channels.
- Managing the hiring process with respective managers.
- Source candidates via LinkedIn, CV databases, and referrals.
- Screen CVs and conduct initial phone/video interviews.
- Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers.
- Manage candidate communication and provide timely feedback.
- Organise and participate in the Job Interview process, prepare offer letter, contract, and onboarding of new employees.
- Perform DBS, DBS Renewal, reference check and other suitable checks as needed and create ID & maintain all employee records for staff.
- To develop, implement and maintain HR documents such as Employee handbook, letters, offer letters, contracts, New Starter form and other documents and ensure compliance with all relevant legislation.
- Coordinate with managers to allot mandatory training required by the company.
- Provide induction as necessary and inform payroll about starters and leavers for each month.
- Maintain accurate records in the ATS (Applicant Tracking System) to provide a monthly report on recruitment to Directors.
- Liaising with Agency staff on a regular basis for eligible candidates and negotiating the rates.
- Advise managers and employees on right to work and vetting and barring requirements relating to employment, and oversee appropriate actions are taken, including submission of certification of sponsorship applications and vetting and barring applications as appropriate.
- Provide references such as Employee reference, VISA and immigration reference, Housing /Mortgage renting reference, and Council request.

Person Specification:
- Previous HR experience in an office setting required.
- Excellent IT skills, i.e. Microsoft Word, Excel, and other commonly used software
- Good oral and written communication skills
- Ability to follow directions.
- Professional, friendly, and detail oriented.
- Organised, reliable and flexible.
- Confident using email, calendars, and basic system.
- An effective team player
- Adhere to all company policies and procedures.
- Ability to work on own initiative, demonstrates organisational skills.
- Conduct initial phone screens to create shortlists of qualified candidates.
- Interview candidates in-person for a wide range of roles (junior, senior and executive).
- Track hiring metrics including time-to-hire, time-to-fill and source of hire.
- Host and participate in job fairs.
- Follow up with candidates throughout the hiring process.
- Maintain a database of potential candidates for future job openings.
- Screening prospective job applicants to evaluate their skills and qualifications.
- Confident using email, calendars, and basic systems

Note: No job description can be considered complete, and this job description will be subject to review and may be amended following consultation to reflect any changes that may occur and to meet the needs of the Company and its service users.
